text:
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on yearly bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the title block.
The first initiated by eng. Mohamed 
Mostafa El-Zalabany, tested by eng. Samir Ouf Hassoub, accepted by 
general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector 
of Damanhour power station, and 
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia Diab WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet ... 
etc

safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet ... 
etc
Motor is out of service for some works if 
 necessary.
Switch off the CB and 
 withdraw it from its cell.
Switch off the DC power 
 supply for this CB.
Tools and Equipment
Electrical equipment kit.
Electrical equipment kit.
Digital voltmeter, Megger 
 500 V.
Dry cloth, air blower.
Work to be carried out
General cleaning for the CB.
Retighten the bolts and nuts for the CB
Check ON / OFF circuit of CB
Check performance of the limit switch.
Check the operation of charging motor and charging of spring.
Check the racking mechanism to ensure it is in the 
 disconnection position.
Check the voltage control at the power source and check that 
 there is no line drop between the power source and the breaker.
